title: CMS Provider Data and Medicare data (data.cms.gov)
questions: hospital star ratings in a state
Medicare enrollment by state over time
Medicare spending per beneficiary by state
Medicare Part D spending on a drug

manual.how: Provider data: open https://data.cms.gov/provider-data/dataset/<id> and click Download (full CSV), or open the JSON links in INSTRUCTIONS.md (filtered, 500 rows a page). Medicare data-api datasets: open the dataset page on data.cms.gov, use Export or Download, or open the JSON links. Upload the files.

cache.why: Queries are filtered and small; provider data refresh monthly or quarterly. data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: CMS data on data.cms.gov are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); see https://data.cms.gov/terms-of-use. Cite CMS and the dataset.

citation: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, {dataset}, data.cms.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which reporting period? Provider Data measures cover rolling multi-year windows that differ by measure (see each row's start_date and end_date); Medicare datasets are by calendar year.
Original Medicare (fee-for-service) only, or including Medicare Advantage? Geographic Variation, inpatient and physician files cover fee-for-service only.
Actual or price-standardized spending? Geographic comparisons should use standardized amounts.
